observed_value: cost_currency stored as U_CAD/U_GBP on FX03 rows
anchor_value: source schedule shows CAD/GBP only in Par Amount / Shares while Amortized Cost and Fair Value are separate valuation columns

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments (1) | Footnotes | Asset Type | Reference Rate and Spread (2) | Interest Rate | Maturity Date | Par Amount / Shares (3) | Amortized Cost (4) | Fair Value | Percentage of Net Assets
Onyx-Fire Protection Services Inc. | (6)(13)(15)(17) | First Lien Term Loan | C + 4.50 % | 6.78 % | 7/31/2031 | CAD 20,153 | 14,532 | 14,373 | 0.67

findings.detail: The extractor assigned the local par-amount unit (CAD/GBP) to cost_currency even though amortized cost is a separate valuation column.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. The schedule header separates Par Amount / Shares from Amortized Cost and Fair Value. In the cited CAD and GBP rows, the local currency prefix appears only with the Par Amount / Shares value (for example CAD 20,153 and GBP 1,962), while Amortized Cost is the following numeric valuation column (14,532 and 2,600 respectively). Therefore storing cost_currency as U_CAD/U_GBP reflects unit propagation from the par amount field, not the source currency of the amortized-cost valuation. No aggregate anchor was needed because this is a localized row/column currency-unit defect.
